placements.why: The envelope's entire content is a calibration report for a named instrument, grounded in verification against external reference plates. No existing strata or narrative structure exists in this repo to hold organizational-record content of this kind, and 'Calibration' is itself one of the org's named top-level strata categories (Opportunity/Strategy/Product/Architecture/Organization/Proof/Templates/Calibration) — it has simply not yet been instantiated by any prior envelope. Minting it here gives calibration-themed narrative leaves a legible home.
placements.title: Instrument calibration as a tracked organizational record
placements.frame: Does this envelope report instrument calibration work whose settledness is warranted by verification against a reference standard, rather than by the instrument's own say-so?

placements.title: Calibration state is warranted by verification against an external reference, not by the instrument's own report
placements.frame: What external reference standard or verification act is cited as the warrant for this instrument's calibration claim, and does it hold across the full observing range asserted?
placements.why: src-1 asserts the Kestrelwood spectrograph's calibration at 88.4 MHz and grounds its settledness explicitly in verification against the June reference plates, holding across the full observing band. src-3 restates the same warrant in labelled-field form ('verified against June reference plates'). This is a directional, recurring theme — future calibration envelopes will keep feeding claims of the form 'calibrated, warranted by verification against reference X' — not a one-time fact, so it passes the narrative grain test. No existing leaf structure exists in this repo to reuse, so this is minted fresh under the newly minted Calibration strata.
